svg.title: GitHub Actions to AWS with OIDC: build, trust and deploy
svg.desc: A merge to main runs the build job with no AWS access: build once, Trivy gate, attest. A reviewer approves the production environment. The deploy job sends its OIDC token to AWS STS, which refuses a pull_request subject and accepts only the production environment subject and audience, assumes the scoped deploy role and returns one-hour credentials. The job pushes the scanned image to Amazon ECR by digest, ECS rolls the new tasks on image@sha256 and verify-deployment confirms there was no rollback.
svg.text: HARBOR GOODS · GITHUB ACTIONS TO AWS WITH OIDC

g.text: Keyless path from GitHub to AWS, defined in Terraform
Build once · Trivy gate · attest · reviewer approves
Only the production subject gets 1-hour credentials
Push by digest · ECS rolls · verify catches a rollback
